Initial release of the Flyelep product color change skill.

- Supports intelligent color changing of products in images via the Flyelep AI HTTP API.
- Requires POST requests with user-provided secretKey for authentication.
- Allows color modification using clear text prompts, supporting details like preserving material, light, or branding.
- Supports model selection between gemini-2.5 (default) and gemini-3-pro.
- Returns the URL of the color-changed image; does not directly process or display image content.
- Provides guidance on prompt writing, error handling, and best practices for optimal results.
